cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent surfactant is a nonionic glucoside (Decyl Glucoside 2), with mild anionics (3, 4) -> low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: the only conditioning route is a cationic starch at 11, after Parfum; no silicone, lipid, protein or prominent humectant.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The cationic starch provides some slip.

weightPotential.rationale: Single light, late cationic starch -> low.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Single deposition family, late and light; nothing to accumulate.
